messages.author: 246097adfa09eddd
messages.subject: summarizing model output from dlply
parts:
Hi D-RUG,

I'm having some trouble figuring out how to summarize the output from a dlply model. I'm regressing tree height and diameter by species code (which is numeric, maybe this matters) by 1 degree latitude/longitude grid cells (factor). Any ideas on how to create a data frame summarizing the output by species code and lat/lon cells with other column headings from regression output?

Below is sample code. Any suggestions would be much appreciated!

Thanks,
Catherine

#############################################################################
library(lmodel2)
#http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/lmodel2/lmodel2.pdf

#SAMPLE DATA
dia=c(8:27)
ht=c(32:51)
spcd=c(94,94,94,94,94,94,94,94,94,94,122,122,122,122,122,122,122,122,122,122)
latlon=c("61.5_-149.5","61.5_-149.5","61.5_-149.5","61.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5",
         "60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5",
         "61.5_-149.5","61.5_-149.5","61.5_-149.5","61.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5",
         "60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5","60.5_-149.5")
data=data.frame(spcd,latlon,dia,ht)

#THE MODEL
lm = lmodel2(log10(ht) ~ log10(dia),range.x="relative",range.y="relative",data=data,nperm=99)
model <- function(data)
{
  lmodel2(log10(ht) ~ log10(dia),range.x="relative",range.y="relative",data=data)
}

#THE OUTPUT
output <- dlply(data, .(spcd,latlon), model)
str(output)

###  IDEALLY NEW DATAFRAME WOULD INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING COLUMN HEADINGS ALONG WITH SPCD
###  AND LATLON WITHOUT HAVING TO CODE EACH UNIQUE SPECIES / LATLON COMBINATION BY HAND

n = output$`122.61.5_-149.5`$n
SMAintercept = output$`122.61.5_-149.5`$regression.results[3,2]
SMAslope = output$`122.61.5_-149.5`$regression.results[3,3]
r = output$`122.61.5_-149.5`$r
rsquare = output$`122.61.5_-149.5`$rsquare
p = output$`122.61.5_-149.5`$P.param

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: summarizing model output from dlply
parts:
It's a bit ugly, but... 

combo.out <- function(models, labels=FALSE){
names = names(output)
n = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$n))
SMAintercept = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$regression.results[x$regression.results$Method =="SMA",][2]))
SMAslope = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$regression.results[x$regression.results$Method =="SMA",][3]))
r = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$r))
rsquare = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$rsquare))
p = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$P.param))

df <- data.frame(names, n, SMAintercept, SMAslope, r, rsquare,p)
row.names(df) <- NULL
return(df)
}

combo.out(output)

parts:
Just realized a typo. names should be names <- names(models), otherwise if you change the name of the dlply() output it won't work. 

combo.out <- function(models, labels=FALSE){
names = names(models)

n = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$n))
SMAintercept = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$regression.results[x$regression.results$Method =="SMA",][2]))
SMAslope = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$regression.results[x$regression.results$Method =="SMA",][3]))
r = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$r))
rsquare = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$rsquare))
p = unlist(lapply(models, function(x) x$P.param))

df <- data.frame(names, n, SMAintercept, SMAslope, r, rsquare,p)
row.names(df) <- NULL
return(df)
}
